question: In the sport of ______ two teams of five players each attempt to score points by putting the ball into a hoop that is 10 feet off the ground
solution:
The correct answer is __**basketball.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **basketball**, **two teams of five players **each play against each other to score points by putting the** ball into a hoop** that is **10 feet off **the ground.
 
• Basketball is a popular sport played around the world, with **millions of fans and players.**
 
• The game of basketball was invented by **Dr. James Naismith in 1891,** and it has since become one of the most widely played and watched sports in the world. 
 
• Basketball is a **fast-paced and exciting sport** that requires skill, teamwork, and athleticism.
 
• The rules of basketball are fairly simple, but the game can be **challenging and competitive,** with many different strategies and tactics that players can use to try to win.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton** is a **racquet sport** that is played by **two or four players** who hit a shuttlecock over a net using their racquets.

 
 
• It is a popular sport in many countries, including** India, China, and Indonesia.**
 
 
 
• **Rugby** is a **contact sport **that is played by **two teams of 15 players** each who try to carry or kick a ball over the other team's goal line.
 
 
• It is a physically demanding sport that originated in **England in the 19th century. **
 
 
 
• **Lawn tennis** is a sport that is played by** two or four players **who hit a ball over a net using their racquets.
 
 
• It is a popular sport around the world, with major tournaments such as **Wimbledon and the US Open** attracting millions of viewers each year.
